### problem_chain
- Root: the customer wants this month's late charge posted correctly → `fleet_ext_month_end_late_charge` (authorized: "go ahead and post whatever the correct late charge is").
- Prerequisite sentences and opening state:
  - tire: past-due no-discount tire invoice 219091e6 (FI-45531395, 2026-08-24, due 09-23, 1011.72, disc 0.00) carries no credit memo → false. Resolver: `fleet_ext_tire_discount_restore` (agent).
  - brake: 5927ebca (FI-45531358, 2026-08-20, due 09-19, 915.92, disc 0.00) no credit memo → false. Resolver: `fleet_ext_brake_discount_restore` (agent).
  - trip: the contested visit fee 297675db (FI-45531247, 2026-08-29, 49.00) has no open dispute (only dispute 75cbef2b, resolved_no_credit, on dfba359e) → false. Contest intent elicited ("Only if asked about the mobile visit … a full trip fee for that seemed too much"). Resolver: `fleet_ext_trip_fee_dispute` (owner=user).
- Tree: late ← {tire, brake, trip}; n=3, all value_input (credit memos and open disputes enter `past_due_basis`) ≥ 2; one user-owned write; acyclic. Order: tire, brake, trip (any order) → late charge.
- Load-bearing runs (late charge): skip tire → 15.66; skip brake → 15.85; skip trip → 15.51; all ≠ 15.43.
- Tool bodies do not check prerequisites. Persona raises only the late charge; the held-back invoices and the trip-fee complaint are given only on request; closes when told the charge is posted. Isomorphic to the declared edges.

### task_independent_derivation
1. **Tire pricing correction** (agent) on 219091e6: tire set 75d62de8 (HT LT 65K, 4 tires, T-46082417); disposal 4×4.25 = 17.00; certificate 582f21d6 4×34.20 = 136.80; discountable 1011.72 + 0 − 17.00 − 136.80 = 857.92. Points: tire invoices < 12 months = 7 → 1; other-vehicle invoices same day/store (6f997f6a) = 1 → 0.5; roadside allowances < 24 months = 6 → 0.5; late charges < 12 months = 1 (2026-04-30; 2025-09-30 at exactly 12 months excluded) → standing ½. Rate 10 + 2×½ = 11%. Method: set instant savings 50.00 applies (4 ≥ 4) → (857.92 + 50) × 11% = 99.8712 → 99.87 − 50 = **49.87**; room 1011.72. `credit_fleet_tire_discount_840e1cf3(00f9727d…, 219091e6…, 49.87)`.
2. **Brake pricing correction** (agent) on 5927ebca: jobs 7564fb41 (front, Severe-Duty, rotors replaced) and b40eda8b (rear, Severe-Duty, resurfaced), labor 2×159.99 = 319.98; shop supplies min(5%·319.98, 35) = 16.00; discountable 899.92. Scope: Severe-Duty, no non-applicable line → labor + rotor work 319.98 + 2×109.99 + 2×29.99 = 599.94. Rate 12 + volume 1 (3 brake invoices < 12 months) + axle 1 (both) + fleet size 0.5 (36 enrolled − 1 removed = 35) + tenure 1 (88 months) = 15.5%. 599.94 × 15.5% = 92.9907 → **92.99**. `credit_fleet_brake_discount_3a9816af(00f9727d…, 5927ebca…, 92.99)`.
3. **Trip-fee dispute** (user) on 297675db: visit 2026-08-29 (Saturday), store 4371 Reynoldsburg; vehicles served 4 (tire invoices of 4 distinct vans); min 3 → schedule 49 − 12×1 = 37.00; weekend +8.00; tire installs booked for 08-29 at 4371 = 4 → −10.00; visit-fee invoices < 12 months = 3 → −2.50; fee owed 32.50; disputed 49.00 − 32.50 = **16.50**. Handed to the customer: `file_fleet_trip_fee_dispute_f6605125(00f9727d…, 297675db…, 16.50)`.
4. **Late charge** (agent), after 1–3: past-due invoices due before 09-30 total 30,483.07 + late charges 10.00 − payments 27,904.03 − credit memos 142.86 − open disputes 16.50 = 2,429.68 (= 612.40 + 915.92 + 1011.72 + 49.00 − 142.86 − 16.50). Rate 1.5 − 0.25 (balance 3,005.03 ≤ ¼·50,000) − 0.25 (remittances since 08-31 = 5,295.33) − 0.10 (invoices < 12 months 30,392.92) = 0.90%. Seasoned (88 months, 1 late charge < 12 months) → 1000 × 0.90% + 1429.68 × 0.45% = 15.43356 → **15.43**. `assess_fleet_late_charge_341e13fe(00f9727d…, "2026-09", 15.43)`.
- Opening-world root value: 16.15. Terminal: two pricing_correction memos (49.87, 92.99), one open dispute 16.50, late charge 15.43 for 2026-09; balance 3147.89 → 3020.46.

## findings
- **F-2 (SOURCE-FACTOR RED — unreal ladder, cited from `_difficulty.md` § findings)**. Demonstration on this world: base fleet_evt_invoice posting FI-45531395 correctly (10% on the ticket's pre-tax price net of the 50.00 instant savings per tires_purchase_ticket, excluding disposal and certificate) gives a 85.79 discount; the "correction" under `ticket_promotion_method` tier 1 restores only 49.87 even at the boosted 11% rate — the business pays 35.92 more than if Crestline had posted the ticket right. FI-45531358: posting gives 12% × 899.92 = 107.99 (Severe-Duty is `fleet_discount_applicable: true`, pads not excluded); `brake_line_scope` tier 2 restores 92.99 at 15.5% — 15.00 short. With the two method factors struck, the tire and brake computations each keep 4 parameter factors and **0 method** factors (below the ≥1 method floor). A reader applying the posting rule instead gets 85.79 / 107.99 and a late charge of 15.20 (vs 15.43). Affected: extended.yaml tire `ticket_promotion_method` / brake `brake_line_scope` and their rule sentences; scored tire/brake amounts and the late charge.
- O-11 (from `_difficulty.md`): correction-only points (11% and 15.5% vs program 10% / 12%) — observation.
- O-T1-1: the sibling tire invoices of 2026-08-29 (1078.62 + 110.52 discount each, identical although van df8027d0 has indirect TPMS) do not reconcile with their tire sets/certificates under tires_purchase_ticket (≈1011.72/997.76 pre-discount); they feed only counts and the 12-month volume (30,392.92, tier robust) — no scored value moves.
- O-T1-2: O-1 (invoice vs vehicle count) not triggered: 4 invoices = 4 distinct vans.
